a subpopulation of mice from the Harlan strain C57BL6/J (C57BL/6H) is characterized by a chromosomal α-synucleinc deletion, which does not affect the expression of β-synucelin and γ-synucleinc.
a chromosomal deletion in the α-synucelin locus is present in a subpopultion of C57BL6/J mice, and that it does not cause a compensatory upregulation of synphilin or other synuclein isoforms.

the C57BL background is not suitable for α-synucleine knockout studies.

the deletion is a genetic artifact that is only found in a subpopulation and that the deletion is not associated with phenotypic abnormalities.
the C57BL strain is not as homogenous as expected.

the genetic background of the inbred mouse strain should be carefully considered in all experiments involving inbred mice.
